amount.description: class_conversion between accounts: the carrying amount of the shares converted, in the base currency [accountant to confirm the basis]. Shown for issue_cash: shares × price under RND-LINE.

buyer_id.description: transfer: the holder they go to, a contact marked shareholder or investor.

class_account_id.description: The class's share-capital account (3010 ordinary, 3020 preference); a conversion's class it converts from.

class_id.description: The share class, a recorded class of that account (FR-EQ-16). Left out: the account's first recorded class, if it has one.

holder_id.description: issue_cash: the subscriber, a contact marked shareholder or investor; class_conversion: the holder whose shares convert.

instrument_id.description: instrument_conversion: the recorded SAFE or note converting, whose holder and class it takes.

kind.description: issue_cash: shares allotted to one subscriber for cash; transfer: shares from one holder to another; class_conversion: one holder's shares into another class; reversal: undoes an effective transaction; instrument_conversion: a SAFE or note converting into shares at a priced round, drafted from the round with draftInstrumentConversions.

price.description: issue_cash: the price per share in the base currency, above zero, at most 6 decimals; transfer: the price agreed per share, for information (share duty is the parties' matter).

reason.description: reversal: what was wrong, such as the ACRA extract shows another number of shares (FR-EQ-26).

resolution_refs.description: The shareholders' approval and the board resolution, by reference: needed for an issue and a conversion.
examples: Board resolution 5 Mar 2027; shareholders' resolution 5 Mar 2027

reverses_id.description: reversal: the effective transaction it undoes.

review.description: instrument_conversion: what the accountant completes in a conversion no enabled template covers (⚠), as it was drafted.
examples: the accountant completes it: it follows no template, a discount

round_id.description: instrument_conversion: the approved issue for cash, the priced round, it converts at.

seller_id.description: transfer: the holder the shares come from.

shares.description: The number of shares, a whole number above zero; a conversion's shares out.

to_class_account_id.description: class_conversion: the share-capital account of the class the shares convert into.

to_class_id.description: class_conversion: the class they convert into.

to_shares.description: class_conversion: the number of shares in, a whole number above zero.
